verdict.rationale: OpenRouter documents programmatic API key management (create/rotate keys for automated distribution), workspace budgets that cap spend per interval, and BYOK for provider-level key control, all of which support issuing limited-scope credentials to agents; community corroborates per-key expiry/limits as a valued feature. However, evidence doesn't show fine-grained scoping (e.g., restricting a key to specific models/tools) beyond budget caps. Missing for 10: documented per-key model/tool permission restrictions, explicit revocation workflow details, independent verification of least-privilege enforcement beyond spend limits.
